items.scene: A BEE in the AIR (BYEHR) buzzes above one closed brown BEER bottle, cap on, standing on the high shelf; nobody drinks it.
A SEAGULL (see-GAH) stands guard on top of a sealed, untouched packet of CIGARETTES (see-gah-REHT) on the counter.
The zinc BAR counter (BAHR) is polished so bright it gleams like one giant silver ingot BAR.
A sleepy brown owl sitting on the zinc counter hugs a tiny cup of black COFFEE (kah-FAY) in both wings to stay awake.
A ginger cat sitting on the counter swishes its long TAIL (TAY) down the front, its cup of TEA on a saucer by its paw.
A white goose on the counter honks 'ah-PAY-ree-TEEF!' beside a small pre-dinner APERITIF glass and a bowl of green olives; nobody drinks.
